Found by s527e (PPI Â§49 review probes).

REPRO (perl 5.40.3 prints stash-z; PCL main and s527e print no-z):
  *main::{HASH}->{zz} = 5; print exists $main::{zz} ? "stash-z\n" : "no-z\n";

PCL emits (p-gethash-deref (p-glob-slot (p-stash "main") "HASH") "zz"): the HASH slot of the stash glob *main:: comes back :undef, so the deref autovivifies a throwaway hash.  In perl *main::{HASH} is a reference to the stash %main:: itself.  t/op/gv.t:549 and t/uni/gv.t (*slosh::{HASH}->{ISA}=[]) use it.  Layer: runtime (p-glob-slot of a p-stash glob, HASH -> the stash as a hash).  Pre-existing: identical on main c903838f.
subject: *main::{HASH} (the HASH slot of a STASH glob) is not the stash: *main::{HASH}->{k} = v writes nowhere (silent wrong)
